note: Grounded prompt library across the engine's LLM stages. Every prompt judges ONLY provided material (engine output / RAG statute context / live page text); no priors, no fabrication. Placeholders {..} are filled from engine-bridge.js / statute-rag.js / the scan.

prompts.purpose: Verify a 'missing disclosure' finding against the real page (evidence-lock)
prompts.template:
You are a compliance auditor. Use ONLY the material provided below. Do not use outside knowledge or assume facts not present. If the material is insufficient, say so.
Requirement the page must satisfy: "{requirement}"
Page text:
"""{ctx}"""
Does the text ALREADY satisfy the requirement? Answer SATISFIED or MISSING on line 1; if SATISFIED quote the exact words.

prompts.purpose: Verify a 'missing disclosure' finding against the real page (evidence-lock)
prompts.template:
Requirement: "{requirement}". Statute basis:
{statute}
Page text:
"""{ctx}"""
Is the required disclosure present in READABLE text (not only a script)? SATISFIED/MISSING + quote.

prompts.purpose: Verify a 'missing disclosure' finding against the real page (evidence-lock)
prompts.template: The finding claims the firm is MISSING: {requirement}. Before we assert this, confirm we actually read the relevant page-type. Pages inspected: {checked_urls}. If the target page was not fetched, answer CANNOT_ASSERT.

prompts.purpose: Verify a 'missing disclosure' finding against the real page (evidence-lock)
prompts.template:
Does the page contain the required element expressed in any reasonable wording (not just the exact phrase)? Requirement: {requirement}. Text:
"""{ctx}""" Answer SATISFIED/MISSING + quote.

prompts.purpose: Verify a 'missing disclosure' finding against the real page (evidence-lock)
prompts.template:
A must_appear disclosure was scored MISSING. Could it be present but JS-rendered/embedded? Note any consent-tool/script signals. Text:
"""{ctx}"""

prompts.purpose: Verify a 'missing disclosure' finding against the real page (evidence-lock)
prompts.template: Confirm the requirement genuinely applies to THIS firm's activity before flagging absence. Requirement: {requirement}; firm activity quoted: {activity}.

prompts.purpose: Verify a 'missing disclosure' finding against the real page (evidence-lock)
prompts.template: Is the quoted evidence for this absence finding actually the RELEVANT page (e.g. a real /privacy page), or an unrelated page? Evidence URL: {evidence_url}.

prompts.purpose: Verify a 'missing disclosure' finding against the real page (evidence-lock)
prompts.template: Grade confidence 0-1 that this 'missing disclosure' is a real, current, on-site gap (not archive-sourced, not JS-only). Evidence: {evidence_quote}; via_archive: {via_archive}.

prompts.purpose: Verify a PRESENCE/breach finding: does the quoted text support it?
prompts.template:
You verify website-audit findings. Use ONLY the material provided below. Do not use outside knowledge or assume facts not present. If the material is insufficient, say so.
Finding: "{finding}"
Text quoted verbatim from the website: "{quote}"
Does the quoted text clearly support the finding? YES or NO on line 1, then a six-word reason.

prompts.purpose: Verify a PRESENCE/breach finding: does the quoted text support it?
prompts.template: Finding: "{finding}". Quote: "{quote}". If the match is inside a script/attribute rather than visible prose, answer NOT_VISIBLE.

prompts.purpose: Verify a PRESENCE/breach finding: does the quoted text support it?
prompts.template: Does the quote constitute the PROHIBITED claim the rule targets (e.g. an absolute health-efficacy claim), or is it benign context? Rule: {finding}; quote: "{quote}".

prompts.purpose: Verify a PRESENCE/breach finding: does the quoted text support it?
prompts.template:
Is the quoted claim unsubstantiated puffery banned by the regulator, or a substantiated/qualified statement? Rule: {finding}; quote: "{quote}"; statute:
{statute}

prompts.purpose: Verify a PRESENCE/breach finding: does the quoted text support it?
prompts.template: Rate 0-1 how strongly the quote entails the finding. Below 0.6 -> demote to needs_review. Finding: {finding}; quote: "{quote}".

prompts.purpose: Verify a PRESENCE/breach finding: does the quoted text support it?

prompts.purpose: Verify a PRESENCE/breach finding: does the quoted text support it?

prompts.purpose: 2-sentence, evidence-only executive summary
prompts.template:
You are writing a 2-sentence executive summary for the leadership of {domain}, based ONLY on this audit. Findings:
{top}
Highest single statutory penalty ceiling (a per-framework maximum, NOT a sum): GBP {expo}.
Sentence 1: the single most serious risk and why. Sentence 2: the headline opportunity if fixed. British English, no fabrication, no facts beyond those listed.

prompts.purpose: 2-sentence, evidence-only executive summary
prompts.template: Summarise the compliance posture in one sentence and the ranking/AI-visibility posture in one sentence, using only: {findings}.

prompts.purpose: 2-sentence, evidence-only executive summary
prompts.template: If no critical statutory breach surfaced, write a headline that frames the exposure as lost rankings/buyers/AI-visibility, not fines. Findings: {findings}.

prompts.purpose: 2-sentence, evidence-only executive summary
prompts.template: Write a one-line 'where you stand': N frameworks legally bind you, M rivals ahead. Use only these numbers: bind={bind}, rivals={rivals}.

prompts.purpose: 2-sentence, evidence-only executive summary
prompts.template: For an investor-grade reader, state the firm's single biggest regulatory exposure and its commercial cost, from: {findings}.

prompts.purpose: 2-sentence, evidence-only executive summary
prompts.template: Compliance could not be fully assessed this scan (site blocked a deep read). Write a headline that implies NO clean bill of health while still valuing the ranking/AI findings. Findings: {findings}.

prompts.purpose: 2-sentence, evidence-only executive summary
prompts.template: Write the 'keep it current' line: re-run monthly so a new breach is caught before enforcement or a competitor moves. No fabrication.

prompts.purpose: 2-sentence, evidence-only executive summary
prompts.template: One sentence to the founder: the most credible, specific quick win from {findings}.
